digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI

teaser.en: Its name is the sound you make spitting out the seed after sucking its little yellow fruit.
teaser.sw: Jina lake ni sauti unayotoa ukitema mbegu baada ya kufyonza tunda lake dogo la manjano.
teaser.dg: Dzinare ni sauti unayoihenda uchiteha tembe bada ya kufyondza tundare dide ra rangi ya mandano.

summary.en: *Mpwakapwaka* is a shrub of coastal forest and thicket with large leaves crowded at the tip and small round yellow fruits. Its fruit is sucked and spat out, and its names are among the most playful in Digo.
summary.sw: *Mpwakapwaka* ni kichaka cha misitu ya pwani na vichaka vizito, chenye majani makubwa yaliyosongamana kwenye ncha na matunda madogo ya mviringo ya manjano. Tunda lake hufyonzwa na kutemwa, na majina yake ni miongoni mwa majina ya kichezo zaidi katika Kidigo.
summary.dg: *Mpwakapwaka* ni chitsaka cha matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani, chenye makodza makulu ganayokusanyika ntsani na matunda madide ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano. Matundage nkufyondzwa na ganayobaki nkutehwa, na madzinage ni kahi ya madzina ganayotsekeza zaidi kpwa Chidigo.

about.en: *Mpwakapwaka* is a shrub or small tree, often with a single stem crowned by a tuft of large, feathery compound leaves crowded at the tip, which gives it a slightly palm-like look. It bears small, round yellow fruits.
about.sw: *Mpwakapwaka* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, mara nyingi wenye shina moja lililovikwa kishungi cha majani makubwa ya mchanganyiko kama manyoya, yaliyosongamana kwenye ncha, jambo linaloupa sura inayofanana kidogo na mmea wa jamii ya mnazi. Huzaa matunda madogo ya mviringo ya manjano.
about.dg: *Mpwakapwaka* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, mara nyinji wenye muhi mmwenga tu, na dzulu kuna fungu ra makodza makulu dza manyoya genye makodza madide manji, ganayokusanyika ntsani; kpwa hivyo unaonekana chidide dza muhi wa jamii ya mnazi. Unalavya matunda madide ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka vizito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani.

uses.en: The fruits are edible: they are sucked for their pulp and the rest spat out.
uses.sw: Matunda yake huliwa: hufyonzwa ili kupata nyama yake na kinachobaki hutemwa.
uses.dg: Matundage nkuriwa: nkufyondzwa kuphaha nyama zao, na ganayobaki nkutehwa.

culture.en: Both its names tell a story. *Mpwakapwaka* imitates the spitting sound made after sucking the fruit. Its other name, *mtsungurira kuzimu*, 'peeping into the underworld', refers to its very deep roots.
culture.sw: Majina yake yote mawili yanasimulia hadithi. *Mpwakapwaka* linaiga sauti ya kutema baada ya kufyonza tunda. Jina lake jingine, *mtsungurira kuzimu*, 'unaochungulia kuzimu', linarejelea mizizi yake mirefu sana inayokwenda chini kabisa.
culture.dg: Madzina gosi mairi gana chisa. Dzina *mpwakapwaka* rinaiga sauti ya kuteha bada ya kufyondza tunda. Dzinare ranjina, *mtsungurira kuzimu*, 'unaotsungurira kuzimu', ni kpwa sababu ya miziye inayoinjira tsini sana.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mpwakapwaka* and *mtsungurira kuzimu*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Deinbollia borbonica*. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mpwakapwaka* to a different tree in the same family, the triangle-tops (*Blighia unijugata*), with the Swahili *mkukilemba* and *mwakamwatu*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mpwakapwaka* na *mtsungurira kuzimu*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Deinbollia borbonica*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mpwakapwaka* kwa mti mwingine wa familia hiyo hiyo, mwakamwatu (kwa Kiingereza *triangle-tops*, *Blighia unijugata*), pamoja na majina ya Kiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mpwakapwaka* na *mtsungurira kuzimu*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Deinbollia borbonica*. Mgombato unapha dzina *mpwakapwaka* kpwa muhi wanjina wa jamii iyo hiyo, *nchivuri* (*Blighia unijugata*), na madzina ga Chiswahili *mkukilemba* na *mwakamwatu*.

reason.en: Triangle-tops, which also carries the name mpwakapwaka
